function.name: click
function.description: [ACTION] Click on the target location on the screen (supports element index or absolute normalized coordinates).

target.description: Click target. Can be an element index number (int, e.g. 3) OR normalized coordinates (list of 2 integers, e.g. [500, 600]).

target_description.description: What the target is, in a few words (e.g. 'play button', 'search input', 'video body'). REQUIRED when target is a coordinate pair; ignored for an element index.

times.description: Number of consecutive clicks on this target. Use this for double-clicks or multi-clicks (e.g. 7 to enter developer mode). Default is 1.

delay_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds between consecutive clicks. Default is 100.

function.name: click_sequence
function.description: [ACTION] Executes a sequence of taps one by one in order on the specified targets (e.g. [[500, 280], [885, 362]]). The screen will be returned ONLY after all clicks in the sequence have completed.

sequence.description: List of targets to tap in sequence, e.g. [[500, 280], [885, 362]].

target_descriptions.description: What each target is, in a few words, one entry per sequence entry in the same order (e.g. ['video body', 'skip button']). Required: a coordinate names nothing by itself.

delay_ms.description: Delay between consecutive taps in milliseconds (default 50ms).

function.name: long_press
function.description: [ACTION] Long press on the target location on the screen (supports element index or absolute normalized coordinates).

target.description: Long press target. Can be an element index number (int, e.g. 3) OR normalized coordinates (list of 2 integers, e.g. [500, 600]).

target_description.description: What the target is, in a few words (e.g. 'play button', 'search input', 'video body'). REQUIRED when target is a coordinate pair; ignored for an element index.

function.name: input_text
function.description: [ACTION] Type text into the target input field (supports replacing whole text or appending to the end, and multi-line strings with '\n').

text.description: The text content to input. Supports multi-line content with '\n'.

target.description: Input target field. Can be an input box element index number (int, e.g. 3) OR normalized coordinates (list of 2 integers, e.g. [500, 600]).

target_description.description: What the target is, in a few words (e.g. 'play button', 'search input', 'video body'). REQUIRED when target is a coordinate pair; ignored for an element index.

clear_exist.description: Whether to clear existing text before typing. True (default): clear/replace entire text. False: append at the end of existing content.

function.name: swipe
function.description:
[ACTION] Perform a swipe, drag, or slider-adjustment gesture on the screen.

• Directional Scrolling ('direction'): Recommended for general browsing and standard page scrolling in most scenarios. Automatically computes safe swipe vectors and adaptive duration, retains a ~40% visual overlap anchor for zero-omission traversal, and prevents inertial flings. Supports scoping to a sub-container via 'target'. If it fails on certain custom layouts, fall back to specifying exact coordinates ('start' and 'end') directly.
• Precise Coordinate Gestures ('start', 'end'): Best for local, fine-grained interactions such as adjusting sliders/SeekBars (e.g., volume, brightness, progress bars), drag-and-drop / list reordering, or as a reliable fallback when directional scrolling fails on specific containers. Always drag slightly PAST the target position to overcome touch slop and reliably trigger the update. When setting a slider to Maximum (100%) or Minimum (0%), swipe fully to the extreme boundary.

Args:
    direction: Smart directional scrolling ('up', 'down', 'left', 'right'). Automatically computes safe swipe vectors, retaining 40% visual overlap: 'up' (reveal content below), 'down' (reveal content above), 'left', 'right'.
    start: Start normalized coordinates [start_x, start_y] in 0-1000 scale.
    end: End normalized coordinates [end_x, end_y] in 0-1000 scale.
    target: Optional target element index (e.g. 2) or container bounds [left, top, right, bottom] to scope the directional swipe within.
    gesture: Backward-compatible parameter: direction string OR custom coordinates list [start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y] in 0-1000 scale.
    target_description: What is being dragged, in a few words (e.g. 'brightness slider knob'). REQUIRED for coordinate gestures ('start'/'end' or a coordinates list); ignored for directional scrolling.
    duration: Optional gesture duration in milliseconds (default 800).

direction.description: Direction for scrolling and swiping: 'up' (drags bottom-to-top, scrolling down to reveal content below), 'down' (drags top-to-bottom, scrolling up to reveal content above), 'left' (drags right-to-left, scrolling right), 'right' (drags left-to-right, scrolling left).

start.description: Start normalized coordinates [start_x, start_y] in 0-1000 scale for precise, local interactions (e.g. adjusting sliders, SeekBars, fine range selection, or drag-and-drop).

end.description: End normalized coordinates [end_x, end_y] in 0-1000 scale for precise, local interactions (e.g. adjusting sliders, SeekBars, fine range selection, or drag-and-drop).

target.description: Optional target element index (e.g. 2) or container bounds [left, top, right, bottom] to scope the directional swipe within.

gesture.description: Backward-compatible swipe gesture: smart direction string ('up', 'down', 'left', 'right') OR precise custom coordinates [start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y] in 0-1000 scale.

target_description.description: What is being dragged, in a few words (e.g. 'brightness slider knob'). REQUIRED for coordinate gestures ('start'/'end' or a coordinates list); ignored for directional scrolling.

duration.description: Optional swipe/drag duration in milliseconds (default 800; computed automatically for directional swipes).

function.name: handwrite
function.description:
[ACTION] Hand-write text on a drawing canvas with real pen strokes.

Use this INSTEAD of input_text whenever the screen asks for handwriting: a writing box, a stroke-order hint, a dictation / 默写 / 描红 exercise, or a "get your stylus ready" prompt. Those canvases ignore typed text, and some of them accept pen (stylus) input only.
The stroke trajectory comes from real stroke data, so each character is written in the correct stroke order with the right shape. Never invent stroke coordinates yourself, and never try to draw characters with a chain of swipes.
When the page shows several writing boxes (e.g. 田字格 per character), write ONE character per call into the currently highlighted empty box: bounds must tightly enclose that single box. If the box stays blank, tap it once to focus it, then retry with its real bounds read from the UI elements list.

Args:
    text: Text to write (e.g. '毯', '苹果'). Every character must exist in the bundled stroke database; Chinese characters do.
    target: Canvas element index from the Visible UI Elements list (e.g. 7), or explicit canvas bounds [left, top, right, bottom] in 0-1000 scale. Omit to write into a centered square region of the screen.
    target_description: What the canvas is, in a few words (e.g. 'dictation writing box'). REQUIRED when target is explicit bounds; ignored for an element index.
    source: Input source: 'auto' (default: pen events, retried as finger events when the canvas stays blank), 'stylus' (pen-only canvas), or 'touchscreen' (finger-only canvas).
    stroke_gap_ms: Pause between strokes in milliseconds (default 90).
    point_interval_ms: Extra delay between points in milliseconds (default 0: as fast as the device allows).

text.description: Text to write, e.g. '毯' or '苹果'. Each character must be in the bundled stroke database.

target.description: Canvas element index from the Visible UI Elements list (e.g. 7), or explicit canvas bounds [left, top, right, bottom] in 0-1000 scale. Omit for a centered square region.

target_description.description: What the canvas is, in a few words (e.g. 'dictation writing box'). REQUIRED when target is explicit bounds; ignored for an element index.

source.description: Input source: 'auto' (pen events, retried as finger events when the canvas stays blank), 'stylus' (pen-only canvas), or 'touchscreen' (finger-only canvas).

point_interval_ms.description: Extra delay between points in milliseconds (default 0: as fast as the device allows).

function.name: press_key
function.description: [ACTION] Press a physical or virtual system button (e.g. ENTER, BACK, HOME, APP_SWITCH).

key.description: Standard Android system button name (ENTER, BACK, HOME, APP_SWITCH).

function.name: manage_app
function.description: [ACTION] Launch or force stop a specified application.

app_name.description: Display name or package name of the application.

function.name: wait_for_delay
function.description:
[ACTION] Pause execution and wait for a specified duration in milliseconds.

Use this ONLY for genuinely required durations: a task-mandated wait, a visible
countdown timer, or a loading state that persisted across the previous observation.
Do NOT wait for routine post-action settling—page loads, taps, and navigation are
already covered by the natural turn latency plus the automatic re-observation
after every action; a blind wait just wastes a full turn.

time_in_ms.description: The exact duration to wait in milliseconds. Accurately convert the required time duration into milliseconds based on your objective or plan (e.g., 2000 for 2s, 5000 for 5s, 60000 for 1 minute, 180000 for 3 minutes, 300000 for 5 minutes).
